mechanism.mechanism: The cooling efficiency of a cold plate varies with its height, altering heat transfer and flow distribution to affect the maximum temperature difference in the battery pack.
mechanism.intervention: Redesign the liquid-cooled cold-plate architecture to use a 50 mm cold plate height (the optimal value found) with flow rates in the 0.5–0.75 l/min range, ensuring uniform coolant distribution across all cells.
mechanism.expected_effect: Reduced cell-to-cell temperature gradient (from 11°C to a lower value) during 350 kW fast charging, while maintaining pressure drop below 20 kPa and fitting under the 90 mm floor constraint.
mechanism.mechanism_source_span: "This study focuses on the numerical investigation of the cooling efficiency of a cold plate with different heights for a Li-ion battery pack."
